lines.text: The king's heart is a waterway in the LORD's hand, and the LORD weighs the heart.
Better to live on a corner of the roof than to share a house with a quarrelsome wife.
Whoever shuts his ears to the cry of the poor will cry out too, and justice is a terror to workers of iniquity.
Better to live in the mountains than with a contentious and ill-tempered wife; a foolish man consumes precious treasures.
A horse is prepared for the day of battle, but victory is of the king.
